definitions.explanation: A person who appreciates and has refined taste in fine food and drink.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{美食家|びしょくか}だ。
{美食家|びしょくか}の{友人|ゆうじん}にレストランを{紹介|しょうかい}してもらった。
examples.english: I had my gourmet friend recommend a restaurant.

examples.japanese: {美食家|びしょくか}として{知|し}られる{彼女|かのじょ}のブログには{全国|ぜんこく}の{名店|めいてん}が{紹介|しょうかい}されている。
examples.english: The blog of the well-known food connoisseur features famous restaurants from across the country.

notes:
FORMATION: {美|び} (beautiful) + {食|しょく} (food) + {家|か} (person/expert). The suffix {家|か} denotes a person who specializes in or is known for something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美食家|びしょくか}として{知|し}られる: to be known as a gourmet
- {美食家|びしょくか}の{舌|した}: a gourmet's palate
- {美食家|びしょくか}も{唸|うな}る: to impress even gourmets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グルメ: gourmet (loanword, more casual and commonly used in everyday speech)
- {食通|しょくつう}: food connoisseur (similar formality to {美食家|びしょくか})
- {食|く}いしん{坊|ぼう}: glutton, big eater (focuses on quantity rather than quality)
